effect.shortEffect: All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.
effect.full: The Pokémon’s shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.

french.tid: Grâce à sa carapace qui renferme l’énergie de tous\nles types, les capacités subies par ce Pokémon quand\nses PV sont au maximum ne sont pas très efficaces.

english.tid: The Pokémon's shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.

japanese.tid: 全タイプの力を　秘めた甲羅は HPが　満タンの　ときに　受ける ダメージを　すべて　今ひとつに　する。
